headline: Base Exchanges Surge on Six Fronts
war_summary: Three hours after the last edition the tempo of strategic‑base turnover has risen sharply across the theatre. Weathered Expanse remains the bloodiest sector, its 24‑hour flip count climbing to forty‑two from thirty‑nine and adding roughly 13,600 Colonial and 16,500 Warden casualties in the past day. Fishermans Row continues to churn, recording forty‑six flips centred on Eidolo, Black Well, Arcadia and Fort Ember, up from thirty‑nine. Stlican Shelf has added another flip, reaching thirty‑five across Thornhold, The Pale House, Vulpine Watch and The Old Mourn. Mooring County and Linn Mercy have both spiked, each posting a half‑dozen new flips in the last two hours with fresh events logged at filing time (Mooring County now at nineteen 24‑hour flips, Linn Mercy at fifteen). Farranac Coast and Stonecradle have renewed activity, the former holding eleven daily flips and the latter twelve, while Marban Hollow, Godcrofts and Callahans Passage show only low‑level turnover. Enlistment rates are accelerating in all of the most contested zones, signalling fresh manpower feeding the ongoing exchanges.
